question: According to the constitution, what type of citizenship system does Nepal have?
actual_answer: Nepal has a single federal citizenship system with provincial identity, as per Article 10(2) of the constitution.

question: नेपाली नागरिकसँग विवाह गरेकी विदेशी महिलाले नेपालको नागरिकता पाउन सक्छिन् कि सक्दिनन्?
actual_answer: धारा ११(६) अनुसार नेपाली नागरिकसँग वैवाहिक सम्बन्ध कायम गरेकी विदेशी महिलाले चाहेमा संघीय कानून बमोजिम नेपालको अंगीकृत नागरिकता लिन सक्छिन्।

question: What does Article 12 say about citizenship certificates and gender identity?
actual_answer: As per Article 12, a person who acquires Nepali citizenship by descent can get a citizenship certificate with gender identity mentioned, based on either the mother's or the father's name.

question: धारा १० अनुसार नेपाली नागरिकलाई नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने हकबाट वञ्चित गर्न सकिन्छ कि सकिँदैन?
actual_answer: धारा १०(१) अनुसार कुनै पनि नेपाली नागरिकलाई नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने हकबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन।

question: Can foreign nationals of Nepali origin who acquired foreign citizenship be granted non-resident Nepali citizenship?
actual_answer: Yes, as per Article 14, a person of Nepali origin who acquired foreign citizenship of a country other than a SAARC member state, based on descent or birth, may be granted non-resident Nepali citizenship under federal law, allowing them to enjoy economic, social and cultural rights.

question: धारा १८ अनुसार समानताको हकको बारेमा संविधानले के व्यवस्था गरेको छ?
actual_answer: धारा १८ अनुसार सबै नागरिक कानूनको दृष्टिमा समान हुनेछन् र कसैलाई पनि कानूनको समान संरक्षणबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन। साथै उत्पत्ति, धर्म, वर्ण, जात, जाति, लिङ्ग, आर्थिक अवस्था, भाषा वा क्षेत्रको आधारमा भेदभाव गरिने छैन।

question: Does the Nepali constitution allow capital punishment?
actual_answer: No, Article 16(2) clearly states that no law shall be made providing for the death penalty for any person.

question: What right does Article 24 guarantee regarding untouchability?
actual_answer: Article 24 guarantees the right against untouchability and discrimination. No person shall be subjected to any form of untouchability or discrimination in any private or public place based on their origin, caste, community, occupation, business or physical condition.

question: धारा ३१ ले शिक्षासम्बन्धी कस्तो हक प्रदान गर्दछ?
actual_answer: धारा ३१ अनुसार प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आधारभूत शिक्षामा पहुँचको हक हुनेछ। राज्यबाट आधारभूत तहसम्मको शिक्षा अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क तथा माध्यमिक तहसम्मको शिक्षा निःशुल्क पाउने हक हुनेछ।

question: What does Article 16(1) of the constitution say about the right to live with dignity?
actual_answer: Article 16(1) states that every person shall have the right to live with dignity.
